from __future__ import annotations from fastapi.testclient import TestClient from app.database import app client = TestClient(app) def test_health_endpoint() -> None: response = client.get("/api/health") assert response.status_code == 200 assert response.json()["status"] == "ok" def test_create_project() -> None: response = client.post("/api/projects", json={"name": "Demo", "url": "https://example.com"}) assert response.status_code == 200 data = response.json() assert data["name"] == "Demo"
